evidence.evidence_text: To address these issues, we introduce Polyrating, an expressive and flexible rating system based on maximum a posteriori estimation that enables a more nuanced and thorough analysis of model performance at lower costs.
Rating-based human evaluation has become an essential tool to accurately evaluate the impressive performance of large language models (LLMs).
